name: BASANOS
description: Signed Solidity assurance packs for AICOM ecosystem contracts. Technical layer only — not AgentAuditPool insurance, not MOMUS runtime probes, not THEMIS admission.

verdict.description: PASS / REVIEW / FAIL grade the subject's Solidity. NO_SUBJECT means no Solidity was read at all, so the pack judges nothing — it is neither a clean bill nor an accusation.

provider_pubkey_note: Deliberately absent. This file is stamped by configure_provider.py with whatever identity the machine running it holds, so a committed value is the developer's laptop key, not production's. The pin that matters lives in the Hub's federation_seeds.json and is read from the running container.
